title: A/P Summary vendor names link without any extra permission
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • You are signed in as a user whose role has Reports page access and NO Vendor Order Management, Customers or Invoicing permissions.
custom_steps:
1. Open the Reports menu.
  2. Click "A/P Aging Summary" in the left list.
  3. Click the first vendor name.
  4. Read the page title and the Vendor chip.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 4:

  • A/P Unpaid Invoices opens narrowed to that vendor.

Why this matters: Every report user could drill into a vendor before the release.
